Now I have a complete picture. Let me compile the final analysis.

---

Here is the comprehensive analysis of RPC handler methods in this repository that can transitively cause outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs.

## Project Overview

This is **Memos**, an open-source self-hosted note-taking tool written in Go. It exposes gRPC services via both gRPC-Gateway (REST) and Connect-RPC, registered in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. The core service implementation lives on `APIV1Service` in that same package.

---

## Category 1: Webhook dispatch to user-configured URLs (the primary finding)

The main pipeline for outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs is the **webhook system**. Users configure webhook URLs via the user settings API, and those URLs receive HTTP POST requests when memo events occur.

### The convergence point (bottom of the call chain)

All webhook-triggered outbound HTTP requests flow through a single function:

**`webhook.Post()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go` line 120

This function:
- Serializes the `WebhookRequestPayload` to JSON (line 121)
- Creates an `http.NewRequest("POST", requestPayload.URL, ...)` to the **user-configured URL** (line 126)
- Signs the payload with HMAC-SHA256 if a signing secret is set (lines 133-149)
- Sends the request via `safeClient.Do(req)` (line 152)

The `safeClient` (line 32) has SSRF protection via `safeDialContext` (line 59) which resolves DNS and checks IPs against `reservedCIDRs` defined in `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go` (line 14). Note: this protection can be bypassed if `AllowPrivateIPs` (line 41 of validate.go) is set to `true`.

Almost all webhook dispatches go through the async wrapper:

**`webhook.PostAsync()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go` line 184

This enqueues the payload into `asyncPostQueue` (a buffered channel of size 128, line 39), consumed by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (line 42).

### Intermediate dispatch layer

The webhook dispatch methods on `APIV1Service` in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`:

1. **`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`** (line 15) -- calls `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` with activity type `"memos.memo.created"`
2. **`DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`** (line 20) -- calls `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` with `"memos.memo.updated"`
3. **`DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`** (line 25) -- calls `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` with `"memos.memo.deleted"`
4. **`DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`** (line 30) -- directly fetches webhooks for the related memo's creator and calls `webhook.PostAsync()`

All of the first three go through **`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`** (line 48), which:
- Resolves the memo's creator from the store
- Calls `s.Store.GetUserWebhooks(ctx, creatorID)` to get the user's configured webhook URLs
- Iterates over webhooks, builds payload, and calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)`

There is also a helper **`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`** in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` (line 66) that calls `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`.

### RPC handler methods that trigger webhook dispatch

Here are all the RPC handlers that transitively cause outbound HTTP requests to user-configured webhook URLs:

#### 1. `CreateMemo` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 70

Calls `s.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage)` at line 157.

Call chain: `CreateMemo` -> `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` -> `http.NewRequest("POST", user_URL)`

#### 2. `UpdateMemo` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 401

Calls `s.dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects(ctx, memo, parentMemo, memoMessage)` at line 513.

Call chain: `UpdateMemo` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post`

#### 3. `DeleteMemo` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 518

Calls `s.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook(ctx, memoMessage)` at line 562.

Call chain: `DeleteMemo` -> `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post`

#### 4. `CreateMemoComment` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` line 20

Calls `s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID)` at line 119. Note this also internally calls `CreateMemo` (line 56), which triggers `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` as well.

Call chain: `CreateMemoComment` -> `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post`
Also: `CreateMemoComment` -> `CreateMemo` -> `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` -> ...

#### 5. `SetMemoAttachments` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` line 16

Calls `s.dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects(ctx, updatedMemo, parentMemo, memoMessage)` at line 48.

Call chain: `SetMemoAttachments` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post`

#### 6. `SetMemoRelations` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` line 16

Calls `s.dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects(ctx, updatedMemo, parentMemo, memoMessage)` at line 48.

Call chain: `SetMemoRelations` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post`

---

## Category 2: Other outbound HTTP requests to user/admin-configured URLs

These are not webhook URLs per se, but they make outbound HTTP requests to endpoints configured by the user or admin:

#### 7. `GetLinkMetadata` / `BatchGetLinkMetadata` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go` lines 14, 19

These RPC handlers accept a URL from the request and fetch its HTML content via `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta()` at `/bench/home/work/internal/httpgetter/html_meta.go` line 136. The URL comes directly from the API caller (the `request.GetUrl()` field), not from stored configuration. The httpgetter has SSRF protection via `secureDialContext` (line 51 of html_meta.go).

Call chain: `GetLinkMetadata` -> `getLinkMetadata` -> `fetchHTMLMeta` (= `httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta`) -> `httpClient.Get(urlStr)` (line 141)

#### 8. `Transcribe` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/ai_service.go` line 48

This RPC handler sends audio data to an admin-configured AI provider endpoint. The endpoint is stored in `InstanceAISetting` in the database. For OpenAI providers, it calls out to the configured endpoint via the OpenAI SDK at `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/stt/openai/openai.go`. For Gemini providers, it calls via the Gemini SDK at `/bench/home/work/internal/ai/audiollm/gemini/gemini.go`.

Call chain (OpenAI): `Transcribe` -> `transcribeViaSTT` -> `sttopenai.New(cfg, ...)` -> `transcriber.Transcribe(ctx, req)` -> OpenAI SDK -> HTTP to `cfg.Endpoint`
Call chain (Gemini): `Transcribe` -> `transcribeViaAudioLLM` -> `audiollmgemini.New(cfg, ...)` -> `m.GenerateFromAudio(ctx, req)` -> Gemini SDK -> HTTP to `cfg.Endpoint`

#### 9. `SignIn` (SSO/OAuth2 path) -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go` line 51

When SSO credentials are provided (line 78), the handler calls `resolveSSOIdentity` (at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go` line 104), which:
- Creates an OAuth2 identity provider from admin-configured `TokenUrl` and `UserInfoUrl`
- Calls `ExchangeToken()` at `/bench/home/work/internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go` line 47, which exchanges the authorization code at the configured `TokenURL` via `conf.Exchange(ctx, code, ...)` (line 69)
- Calls `UserInfo()` at line 83, which makes `http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, p.config.UserInfoUrl, nil)` (line 85) and sends it via `client.Do(req)` (line 91)

Both URLs (`TokenUrl` and `UserInfoUrl`) are admin-configured in identity provider settings.

#### 10. `CreateAttachment` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` line 55

When the instance storage is configured to use S3 (admin-configured), `SaveAttachmentBlob` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_storage.go` line 47 calls `s3Client.UploadObject()` which makes HTTP requests to the admin-configured S3 endpoint at `/bench/home/work/internal/storage/s3/s3.go`.

#### 11. `TestInstanceEmailSetting` -- `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go` line 256

Sends a test email to an admin-configured SMTP server via `notification.SendTestEmail()`. While this uses SMTP (not HTTP), it is still an outbound network connection to an admin-configured host.

---

## Summary: Call graph convergence point for webhooks

```
CreateMemo ──────────────────> DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook ──┐
                                                             │
UpdateMemo ──────────┐                                       │
SetMemoAttachments ──┤ dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects ──>    │
SetMemoRelations ────┘   DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook ────>    │
                                                             ├── dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook ──> webhook.PostAsync ──> webhook.Post
DeleteMemo ──────────────> DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook ──────┘
                                                                  (HTTP POST to user-configured URL)
CreateMemoComment ──────────> DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook ──> webhook.PostAsync ──> webhook.Post
                   └──> CreateMemo (internally) ──> DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook ──> ...
```

The single convergence point where all webhook code paths merge before making the actual outbound HTTP request is **`webhook.Post()`** at `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`. All paths go through `webhook.PostAsync()` (line 184), which feeds the async queue that drains through `Post()`.

The user-configured URL is stored in `storepb.WebhooksUserSetting_Webhook.Url`, managed through the `CreateUserWebhook` / `UpdateUserWebhook` RPC handlers in `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go`, and validated at registration time by `webhook.ValidateURL()` in `/bench/home/work/internal/webhook/validate.go:62`.
